guest_profiles_name_length.name: guest_profiles_name_length
guest_profiles_name_length.value: char_length("guest_profiles"."first_name") between 1 and 80 and char_length("guest_profiles"."last_name") between 1 and 80

reviews_title_length.name: reviews_title_length
reviews_title_length.value: "reviews"."title" is null or char_length("reviews"."title") between 1 and 120

itinerary_plans_stay_range.name: itinerary_plans_stay_range
itinerary_plans_stay_range.value: "itinerary_plans"."arrival_date" is null or "itinerary_plans"."departure_date" is null or ("itinerary_plans"."departure_date" >= "itinerary_plans"."arrival_date" and "itinerary_plans"."departure_date" - "itinerary_plans"."arrival_date" <= 21)
